title: Relic Stats: Hextech Runes
description:
Adds [b]Relic Stats[/b] tooltips to the runes (augments) and enemy hexes of [b]ARAM: Mayhem[/b], showing what each one did for you: damage, healing, Block, Energy, cards, powers and more. Every stat shows [b]this combat[/b] first and the [b]total[/b] for the run second.

[b]Required:[/b] Relic Stats, ARAM: Mayhem.
[b]Optional expansions:[/b] ARAM: Mayhem: Extra Expansion Pack and ARAM Mayhem: Watcher Pack. Install them and their runes are tracked too; skip them and everything else still works.

Does not change gameplay.

[h2]Found a bug?[/h2]
Please report it in the [b]Comments[/b] section below this description and say which rune or hex it was. You can also add me on Discord: [b]hgiang[/b].
